==Shatter==
{{PAGENAME}} has a capability/ability to break shields instantly, regardless of how many amount of instances the enemies had. He is great for shield enemies or Shield Challenges. However, he can't hit flying, so for flying enemies with shields, use [[Karyn]], [[Elf Spirit (Wind)]], [[Hammerhead (Shark Empress)]], or [[Gravity Navy (Admiral)]].
